candidate.definition_en: To severely criticize or condemn someone or something; or, in a religious sense, to condemn someone to eternal punishment.
candidate.explanation_ar: أن يلعن أو يحكم على شخص بالهلاك الأبدي، أو ينتقد شخصاً أو عملاً بشدة ويدينه.

senses.definition_en: To criticize or condemn someone or something very harshly as a failure.
senses.definition_ar: ينتقد بشدة أو يدين عملاً أو شخصاً ويعتبره فاشلاً.
examples: Don't damn him for one honest mistake.
Critics tend to damn any film that challenges conventional storytelling.

senses.definition_en: To condemn someone to eternal punishment in hell.
senses.definition_ar: يلعن أو يقضي على الروح بالهلاك والعذاب الأبدي.
examples: Strict doctrines warn that sin will damn the soul to eternal punishment.
Don't damn him for one honest mistake.
Critics tend to damn any film that challenges conventional storytelling.
Strict doctrines warn that sin will damn the soul to eternal punishment.
candidate.mnemonic: شبه 'Dam' 'سد'.. لما الـ 'Dam' اتكسر وغرق الدنيا، الناس قالوا 'Damn!'.
